claims: WrestleMania 42 Night 2 took place on April 19, 2026 at Allegiant Stadium, Las Vegas.
Roman Reigns defeated CM Punk in the main event of WrestleMania 42 Night 2.
Roman Reigns became the new World Heavyweight Champion by defeating CM Punk.
Both competitors utilized their finishers in the Roman Reigns vs. CM Punk match at WrestleMania 42 Night 2.
Roman Reigns attempted a GTS in the Roman Reigns vs. CM Punk match at WrestleMania 42 Night 2.
Roman Reigns sealed the victory with multiple spears in the Roman Reigns vs. CM Punk match at WrestleMania 42 Night 2.
The Roman Reigns vs. CM Punk match at WrestleMania 42 Night 2 featured top-rope spots.
The Roman Reigns vs. CM Punk match at WrestleMania 42 Night 2 featured table spots.
The Roman Reigns vs. CM Punk match at WrestleMania 42 Night 2 featured signature moves including Superman punches, spears, and GTS.
CM Punk hit a Go To Sleep (GTS) but couldn't get the win in the Roman Reigns vs. CM Punk match at WrestleMania 42 Night 2.
Roman Reigns dominated with spears after CM Punk was exhausted in the Roman Reigns vs. CM Punk match at WrestleMania 42 Night 2.
Roman Reigns portrayed himself as the dominant OTC (One True Champion) in the Roman Reigns vs. CM Punk match at WrestleMania 42 Night 2.
Roman Reigns took back the Ula Fala from CM Punk in the Roman Reigns vs. CM Punk match at WrestleMania 42 Night 2.
Roman Reigns held up the Ula Fala in the Roman Reigns vs. CM Punk match at WrestleMania 42 Night 2.
